## Description

Deploy the AI service image (API and worker) to the Azure India dev environment with no public ingress, its own medvya_ai database on the dev PostgreSQL server and its own blob container. Meet the ADR-021 conditions before real patient data: Medvya calls with a managed-identity token and the service trusts the asserted tenant and user only from it; AUTH_MODE=disabled is refused outside development; the data-key wrapping key comes from Key Vault; telemetry scrubbing becomes an allow-list; Speech and a Standard (regional) Foundry deployment run in India with evidence attached.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The AI service answers only Medvya's API on the dev network; a request from anywhere else is refused.
- [ ] **AC2.** A call without Medvya's service identity, or asserting a tenant without it, is refused (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** The service refuses to start with AUTH_MODE=disabled outside development.
- [ ] **AC4.** Portal or CLI evidence shows the Speech resource and a Standard Foundry deployment in an Indian region.
- [ ] **AC5.** A synthetic consultation goes from record to draft on dev in ≤ 60 s p50 (MDV-P3-025 method).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
